**Not in this slice:** changing which fields promote applies, or `import`.

## Why

`promote` takes the lead and sections from a one-item outline and keeps the item's own fields. An outline field it does not apply should be refused, as s328 made it refuse `short_title` through `ops._SOURCE_FIELD_DEFAULTS`. `parent` and `discovered_from` are still dropped without a word, so an author who puts them in the outline believes they took effect.
